about: The author shows that the kings of Moab and Amalek are of Shem's seed by retelling Genesis 19: God sends the angels Michael and Gabriel to bring Lot out of Sodom, his wife turns to a pillar of salt, and his two daughters make him drunk in turn; the elder bears Moab, the younger Ammon, said here to be the king of the Amalekites.

sentences.l: And-king-of Moab-also seed-of Shem he, and-we-will-inform-you how-also it-was.
sentences.i: Now the king of Moab too is of the seed of Shem, and we shall tell you how that came about.
sentences.n: ወ- 'and' opens the unit; the enclitic -ሂ on ሞአብሂ is 'also, too', continuing the series of kings shown to be of Shem. ወንጉሠ ሞአብ and ዘርአ ሴም are construct chains ('king-of Moab', 'seed-of Shem'); ውእቱ 'he' is the copula 'is'. ወናየድዐክሙ is ወ- + ናየድዐክሙ 'we shall inform you', the ʾa-stem (causative) of the root ydʿ with the object -ክሙ 'you (pl.)', as in ch. 77. ዘከመሂ is ዘ + ከመ 'how' + -ሂ; ኮነ 'it was, it came about'. This unit opens the Moab story, which is told from Genesis 19.

sentences.l: And-they-destroyed her, and-they-brought-out to-Lot with his-children; and-his-wife-as-for when she-turned behind-her that she-see city-of her-father and-her-mother;
sentences.i: and they destroyed the city, and brought Lot out with his children; but his wife, when she turned back, wishing to see the city of her father and her mother —
sentences.n: ወአማሰኑ ኪያሃ 'and they destroyed her' is the causative of ማሰነ 'perish' with the independent object ኪያሃ 'her' (the city, feminine). ወአውፅእዎ is ወ- + 'they brought him out', Lot named after it with ለ- marking the object (as in the last unit). ደቂቁ 'his children' is ደቂቅ + -ሁ. In ወብእሲቱሰ the -ሰ is a contrastive 'as for' (as in ወውእቱሰ): 'but his wife'. ተመይጠት 'she turned' is the 3fs perfect of the tä-stem of the root m-y-ṭ; ድኅሬሃ 'behind her' means 'back'. ከመ ትርአይ is the subjunctive 'that she see'; ሀገረ አቡሃ ወእማ 'the city of her father and her mother' (hers: -ሃ). The sentence about the wife is left hanging and is taken up in the unit beginning ወሶበ ሰምዐት. The allusion is Genesis 19:26, Lot's wife.

sentences.i: For the wrath of God came down upon the city of Sodom, a rain of fire from heaven that burns mountains and hills, stones and earth, and lightnings and (?) and thunder come down with the voice of God's wrath, and a cloud of fire as well that blackens (?) the (?);
sentences.n: እስመ 'for'. ወረደ 'it came down' (the ወ is part of the root w-r-d); the subject መዐተ እግዚኣብሔር 'wrath-of God' is a construct chain and ዝናመ እሳት 'rain-of fire' is in apposition to it. Genesis 19:24 describes the rain of sulfur and fire. ዘያነድድ 'that burns' is ዘ + the imperfect of the ʾa-stem of ነደደ 'burn'. አድባረ is the plural 'mountains' (of ደብር), read here as an accusative in a list (it could instead be a construct, 'mountains and hills of stones and earth' (?)); ወአውግረ አእባነ ወመሬተ 'and hills (?), stones and earth': አውግር I take as a plural 'hills' but could not confirm it (?). ወይወርድ 'and he/it descends' is ወ- + imperfect. መባርቅት 'lightnings' and ነጐድጓድ 'thunder' are clear; ወፀዓዓት is not a word I could place, perhaps another meteor such as hail or thunderclaps (?). ድምፀ መዐተ is a double construct, 'voice-of wrath-of'. In ወደመና እሳትኒ the -ኒ is 'also'. ዘያጠይሶ ለመርቄ: ያጠይሶ I take as the ʾa-stem of a verb 'blacken' (?), and መርቄ I cannot identify (a place or a thing; ለ- marks it as object) (?); so the end of this unit is uncertain.

sentences.i: And when all this, the sound, was heard, the angels said to Lot: 'Do not turn back; after you have gone out of your city do not turn back behind you, that you may not die.'
sentences.n: ወዝንቱ ኵሉ 'and all this', the topic placed before the clause; ሶበ ተሰምዐ ድምፅ 'when the sound was heard', ተሰምዐ the passive (tä-stem) of ሰምዐ 'hear'. ይቤልዎ 'they said to him' is ይቤሉ + ሎ ('to him'), with ለሎጥ restating who is meant. ኢትትመየጡ is the negative jussive (2mp) of the tä-stem of m-y-ṭ, a warning not to turn back; the plural addresses Lot with his household (Genesis 19:17 has the singular, so the plural is this text's own). ድኅረ እምከመ ወፃእክሙ: ድኅረ 'after', እምከመ 'since, when', ወፃእክሙ 'you (pl.) went out' (ወፅአ). ከመ ሞተ ኢትሙቱ is literally 'that you not die the death' (ሞተ here as a noun 'death' with a figura etymologica: ሞተ ... ኢትሙቱ), which I render 'that you may not die'; the form ሞተ can also be read as the verb 'he died', so the clause is a little uncertain (?).

sentences.i: And when she heard — the wife of Lot, Aqmaba (?) — she turned back and became a pillar of salt, and she is there to this day, to this very day. But Lot, the brother of Abraham, God settled in the mountains of Ararat.
sentences.n: ወሶበ ሰምዐት ይእቲ ብእሲተ ሎጥ: ሰምዐት is 'she heard' (3fs), ይእቲ 'she' repeats the subject, and ብእሲተ ሎጥ is a construct chain 'wife-of Lot'. አቅማባ follows with no marker; I take it as the wife's name, since Bezold gives no other sense (?). She is the woman of Genesis 19:26, turned to ሐውልተ ፄው 'pillar-of salt' (ሐውልት is accusative; ፄው 'salt'). ወሀለወት 'she is there, exists' (ሀሎ); እስከ ዮም ወእስከ ዛቲ ዕለት 'until today and until this day'. ወለሎጥሰ: ለ- marks the object, -ሰ is 'as for'. እኁሁ ለአብርሃም 'his brother, Abraham's' is the text's wording; Genesis calls Lot Abraham's nephew, and 'brother' fits the loose sense of Genesis 14:14. አንበሮ is 'he settled him' (ነበረ causative). The mountains of Ararat (አራራት, Genesis 8:4) is the text's place; Genesis puts Lot in the hills near Zoar. The ፨ ends the account of Lot's rescue and opens the next scene.

sentences.n: ተከለ 'he planted' (3ms perfect, subject Lot); ወይነ is the accusative of ወይን, which means both 'wine' and 'vine'. After a verb of planting I take 'vine', with ሐዲሰ 'new' as its adjective (accusative); the other sense, 'wine', is possible (?). The planting of a vineyard is the story of Noah, Genesis 9:20, which the text compares in the unit beginning ወኖኅሂ.

sentences.i: His daughters made their father drink wine, for they planned an evil plan, and one said to the other: 'This estate of our father — how is it to be lost?
sentences.n: ወአስተያሁ 'and they (fem.) made him drink': the ʾa-stem of ሰትየ 'drink', in the 3fp perfect (አስተያ) with -ሁ 'him'; subject አዋልዲሁ 'his daughters' follows, and ለአቡሆን 'to their father' (-ሆን is 'their (fem.)'). For the story see Genesis 19:30-38. እስመ መከራ ምክረ እኪተ: መከራ I take as the 3fp perfect (-ā, as in the ወአስተያሁ just before, with አዋልዲሁ 'his daughters' as the subject) of መከረ 'take counsel, plan', 'they (both) took counsel', with ምክረ እኪተ 'an evil counsel' as its cognate object. ይቤላ 'he said to her' is masculine and singular in form where a feminine speaker (ትቤላ, as in ch. 79) is expected; I read it as one daughter speaking to the other, with the masculine form standing for ትቤላ, so the clause is uncertain (?). The speech: ንዋየ አቡነ is a construct chain 'goods-of our-father', and the word may mean his property or his line; በአይቴ ይጠፍእ 'in what way will it perish?' (I take the sense 'how', not confirmed in Dillmann (?)). The speech runs into the next unit.

sentences.i: Our mother has perished on the road, and for us too there is no one to marry us here.'
sentences.n: እምነኬ is እምነ 'our mother' + the emphatic -ኬ 'indeed'. ተሀጒለት 'she perished' is the tä-stem of ሀጐለ 'be lost' in the 3fs. በፍኖት 'on the road'. ወለነኒ is ወ- + ለ- + -ነ 'us' + -ኒ 'also'. አልቦ 'there is none' (negative existential) is followed by the relative ዘያወስበነ 'who will marry us': the ʾa-stem of ወሰበ 'take a wife', which I read as 'give a husband to, marry us', not confirmed in Dillmann (?). በዝየ 'here'. The daughters' reasoning is that of Genesis 19:31, where the elder says there is no man left in the land.

sentences.i: So they made their father drunk, and the elder, his daughter, lay with him, at a time when his mind was clouded with wine;
sentences.n: ወአስከራሁ 'and they (the two) made him drunk' is the 3fp perfect (-ā, as in ወአስተያሁ) of the ʾa-stem of ሰከረ 'be drunk', with -ሁ 'him'; the verb then turns to the elder alone (ሰከበት). ሰከበት 'she lay down' (3fs perfect); እንተ ትልህቅ 'she who is elder' (the relative with the imperfect of ልህቀ 'grow great'; the same phrase is in ch. 79), with ወለቱ 'his daughter' added in apposition. ኅበ is a spelling of ኀበ 'where, when', here a conjunction; ጸልመ ልቡ 'his heart was darkened', ልብ also means 'mind'. This is Genesis 19:33.

sentences.i: Now Lot, a righteous man, did not know when his daughter lay down, nor when she rose, for drunkenness darkens the mind.
sentences.n: ወሎጥሰ 'and Lot, as for him' (the -ሰ is contrastive). ጻድቅ 'righteous' is a descriptive adjective set beside the name. ኢያእመረ 'he did not know' (negative of the ʾa-stem አእመረ 'know'; ወኢያእመረ repeats it); በሰኪቦታ and በተንሥኦታ are በ- 'at' + a verbal noun + -ታ '3fs her' ('her lying down', 'her rising'), each with ለወለቱ 'of his daughter' naming whose. The wording is that of Genesis 19:33, 'he did not know when she lay down or when she rose'. እስመ ስካር ያጸልም ልቦ 'for drunkenness darkens his heart (mind)': ያጸልም is the ʾa-stem imperfect of ጸልመ, picking up the verb of the last unit. The exact form of the verbal nouns (ሰኪቦት, from ሰከበ) I could not check (?).

sentences.i: Noah too, in drunkenness, became naked before his wife and his sons, until he cursed his son, the one who had mocked him;
sentences.n: ወኖኅሂ is ወ- + ኖኅ 'Noah' + -ሂ 'also': the text offers Noah as a second example of wine taking away judgement (Genesis 9:20-27, the curse after Ham's mockery). ኮነ ዕሩቀ 'he became naked' (ዕሩቀ is the accusative predicate); እምብእሲቱ ወደቂቁ 'from his wife and his children' I take as 'before, in the sight of' them, though the Geʿez is literally 'from' (?). እስከ ይረግም 'until he cursed' (እስከ with the imperfect). ውሉዶ ለዘ ሰሐቆ: ውሉዶ 'his son' (ውሉድ + -ሁ) is the object, restated by ለዘ ሰሐቆ 'to him who mocked him'; ሰሐቀ is 'laugh, mock'. The curse in Genesis falls on Canaan, Ham's son; the text says only 'his son' and I leave it so.

sentences.i: But for Lot sin was not counted, for he acted without knowing.
sentences.n: ወለሎጥሰ 'but as for Lot'; ኢተኆለቆ 'it was not counted to him' is the negated tä-stem of ኆለቈ 'count' (the house lemma), the final -ቆ read as ቀ + -ሁ 'to him' (it may instead be a spelling of ተኆለቈ (?)), so 'sin was not reckoned (to him)', ኀጢአተ being an accusative that remains with the passive; ለሎጥ marks the one to whom it was not counted. እስመ 'for'; በኢያእምሮ 'in not-knowing' is በ- + the negative ኢ- + a verbal noun; ገብረ 'he did' (3ms perfect of ገብረ). The text is excusing Lot, which Genesis does not do in so many words, though Genesis 19:33 says he did not know.

sentences.i: The elder conceived and bore a son and named him Moab, which means 'from my father, in my lap' (?);
sentences.n: ወፀንሰት ወወለደት 'she conceived and bore' (3fs perfects). እንተ ትልህቅ 'the elder' (as above). ወሰመየቶ ስሞ ሞአብ: ሰመየ 'name' with -ቶ 'him', and ስሞ 'his name' stands in apposition, 'she named him, his name Moab'. The etymology: እምኀበ አቡየ 'from (beside) my father', plain; በብርክየ is በ- + ብርክ 'knee, lap' + -የ 'my', and I am not sure that this is the word or its sense here (?). ብሂል is 'saying, meaning', a noun marking an explanation. Genesis 19:37 names the child Moab; the explanation 'from the father' is a Hebrew-style etymology, and the second phrase is this text's addition.

sentences.i: When the elder had given birth, she said to the younger: 'Come, let us make our father drink wine, and you also, that you may go in to him if you can get children.' And again they prepared wine, and repeated a foolish speech, saying: 'Drink wine, our father, that your heart may be comforted.'

This unit follows Genesis 19:34, where the elder proposes the same plan to the younger.

sentences.i: He is the king of the Amalekites; and so now it is known that the king of Amalek is of the seed of Shem.
sentences.n: ወውእቱ ንጉሦሙ ለዓማሌቃውያን: 'and he is their king, of the Amalekites' (ንጉሥ + -ሙ 'their', then ለ- + the people's name naming the owners). The run of eight ፨ closes the chapter and belongs to this last unit.

glossary.ለእንተ: እንተ — to her who (ለ- + fem. relative pronoun)
glossary.ለወለቱ: ወለት — to his daughter (ለ- + noun + -ሁ '3ms his', contracted -ቱ) · ለ- marking the owner: 'of his daughter' (በሰኪቦታ ለወለቱ 'at her lying down, his daughter's')
glossary.ለዓማሌቃውያን: ዓማሌቃዊ — to the Amalekites (ለ- + plural ዓማሌቃውያን of ዓማሌቃዊ 'Amalekite')
glossary.ለዘ: ዘ — he who, that which (relative pronoun; ለ- 'to')
glossary.መላእክቲሁ: መልአክ — his angels, messengers (plural መላእክት + -ሁ '3ms his')
glossary.መባርቅት: መብረቅ — lightnings (plural መባርቅት of መብረቅ, noun)
glossary.መከራ: መከረ — they (f.) took counsel, planned (3fp perfect, G, m-k-r; the two daughters) (?)
glossary.መዐተ: መዐት — wrath, anger (noun, fem.; construct 'wrath of')
glossary.ምድረ: ምድር — earth, land (noun, construct state 'land-of') · accusative 'a land', 'the ground' (ምድረ ነኪረ 'a foreign land'; እከሪ ምድረ 'I dig the ground')
glossary.ሞተ: ሞተ — he died (3ms perfect, G, m-w-t); ድኅረ ሞተ ሴም 'after Shem died' · noun 'death' in the figura etymologica ከመ ሞተ ኢትሙቱ 'that you not die the death' (?)
glossary.ሞአብ: ሞአብ — Moab (proper name; Lot's elder daughter's son, and his land)
glossary.ሤም: ሴም — Shem (proper name; spelled ሤም here)
glossary.ሰሐቆ: ሰሐቀ — he mocked him, laughed at him (3ms perfect, G, + -ሁ 'him')
glossary.ቃለ: ቃል — word (construct 'word of') · accusative 'a word' (ዘንተ ቃለ 'this word') · 'voice of' in the title ቃለ ታዕካ (?)
glossary.በሰኪቦታ: ሰኪቦት — in her lying down (በ- + verbal noun of ሰከበ + -ሃ '3fs her', written -ታ) (?)
glossary.በብርክየ: ብርክ — in my knee, lap (?) (በ- + noun + -የ '1cs my') (?)
glossary.በተንሥኦታ: ተንሥኦት — in her rising (በ- + verbal noun of ተንሥአ + -ሃ '3fs her', written -ታ)
glossary.በአይቴ: አይቴ — by what, in what (በ- + interrogative 'where, what')
glossary.በኢያእምሮ: አእምሮ — in not-knowing, in ignorance (በ- + ኢ- + verbal noun አእምሮ 'knowledge')
glossary.በእንተ: በእንተ — concerning, about (+ construct) · for the sake of, on account of (በእንተ ፍሥሓ አዳም 'for the joy of Adam')
glossary.በዝየ: ዝየ — here (በ- + adverb ዝየ 'here'; the በ- adds nothing to the sense)
glossary.በፍኖት: ፍኖት — on the road, in the way (በ- + noun, fem.)
glossary.ብሂል: ብሂል — saying, meaning, 'that is' (verbal noun of ብህለ)
glossary.ብእሲተ: ብእሲት — woman, wife (noun, fem., construct / accusative)
glossary.ተሀጒለት: ተሀጕለ — she perished, was lost (3fs perfect, tä-stem of ሀጐለ)
glossary.ተመይጠት: ተመይጠ — it turned (3fs perfect, Gt stem of ሜጠ 'turn', root m-y-ṭ)
glossary.ተሰምዐ: ተሰምዐ — it was heard (3ms perfect, tä-stem passive of ሰምዐ 'hear')
glossary.ተዐውቀ: ዐወቀ — it was/has become known (3ms perfect, tä-stem passive of ዐወቀ 'know' (?); rendered as a present 'it is known')
glossary.ትልህቅ: ልህቀ — who grows great, is the elder (3fs imperfect, G, l-h-q, after እንተ) (?)
glossary.ትረክቢ: ረከበ — you will find (2fs imperfect, G)
glossary.ትርአይ: ርእየ — that she see (3fs subjunctive, G, r-ʾ-y)
glossary.ትባኢ: ቦአ — that you (fs) enter (2fs subjunctive, G)
glossary.ትቤላ: ይቤ — she said to her (3fs ትቤ of defective ይቤ + -ላ '3fs to her')
glossary.ትንእስ: ንእሰ — who is small, least (3fs imperfect, G; after እንተ relative)
glossary.ኀቤሁ: ኀበ — to him (preposition + -hu, ኀቤሁ) · also 'of him' after ሰአለ 'ask' (ሰአለ ኀቤሁ 'he asked of him')
glossary.ኀጢአተ: ኀጢአት — sin (noun, construct state 'sin-of') · accusative object, 'sin' (ያአትት ኀጢአተ 'he takes away sin')
glossary.ናስትዮ: አስተየ — let us make him drink (1cp subjunctive, ʾa-stem causative of ሰትየ, + -ዮ 'him')
glossary.ንዋየ: ንዋይ — goods, vessels, possessions (construct 'goods of') · accusative 'goods' (ወኵሎ ንዋየ ወሀበት 'and all goods she gave')
glossary.ንጉሠ: ንጉሥ — king (accusative) · also construct 'king of' (ንጉሠ ሮምሂ 'the king of Rome too') · predicate accusative 'as king' (ዘይከውን ንጉሠ 'who will be king'; ይኩነነ ንጉሠ 'may he be king for us')
glossary.አልቦ: አልቦ — there is not, none (negative existential) · 'no, not so' as a reply (አልቦ እግዚኦ 'No, O lord', ch. 56)
glossary.አቅማባ: አቅማባ — (?) unidentified; taken as the name of Lot's wife (?)
glossary.አንበሮ: አንበረ — he settled him, set him (3ms perfect, ʾa-stem causative of ነበረ 'dwell', + -ሁ 'him')
glossary.አእባነ: እብን — stones (plural አእባን of እብን, accusative)
glossary.አዋልዲሁ: ወለት — his daughters (plural አዋልድ of ወለት + -ሁ '3ms his')
glossary.አዕደዎ: አዕደወ — he brought him across, led him over (3ms perfect, ʾa-stem causative of ዐደወ 'cross over' (?), + -ዎ 'him') (?)
glossary.አድባረ: ደብር — mountains of (plural አድባር of ደብር 'mountain', construct) · accusative 'mountains' in a list (አድባረ ወአውግረ አእባነ ወመሬተ 'mountains and hills (?), stones and earth'); construct reading also possible (?)
glossary.አፍለሶ: አፍለሰ — he removed him, caused to migrate (3ms perfect, ʾa-stem causative of ፈለሰ 'migrate', + -ሁ 'him', written -ሶ)
glossary.ኢተኆለቆ: ተኆለቈ — it was not counted to him (ኢ- + 3ms perfect, tä-stem passive of ኆለቈ 'count', + -ሁ 'to him', written -ቆ) (?)
glossary.ኢትሙቱ: ሞተ — you (pl.) do not die (ኢ- + 2mp subjunctive/jussive, G, m-w-t)
glossary.ኢትትመየጡ: ተመይጠ — do not turn back (ኢ- + 2mp jussive, Gt stem of ሜጠ 'turn', m-y-ṭ)
glossary.ኢያእመረ: አእመረ — he did not know (ኢ- + 3ms perfect, ʾa-stem 'know')
glossary.እመ: እመ — if (conjunction) · whether (ጐንደይኩ እመ ትገብእ 'I waited whether she would return')
glossary.እምሀገረ: ሀገር — from the city of (እም- + noun, construct)
glossary.እምሀገርክሙ: ሀገር — from your (pl.) city (እም- + noun + -ክሙ '2mp your')
glossary.እምብእሲቱ: ብእሲት — from his wife (እም- 'from' + noun + -ሁ '3ms his', spelled -ቱ)
glossary.እምኀበ: ኀበ — from (እም- 'from' + ኀበ; 'from the side of')
glossary.እምነኬ: እም — our mother indeed (noun እም 'mother' + -ነ '1cp our' + emphatic -ኬ)
glossary.እስከ: እስከ — until, as far as (preposition) · እስከ — conjunction before a verb, 'until' (እስከ የዐዝዞ ማይ 'until the water seizes him')
glossary.እኁሁ: አኅ — brother (noun, base እኁ- before suffixes; + -ሁ 'his', 3ms)
glossary.እንተ: እንተ — which, who (rel. pron. fem.) · in the phrase እንተ ባሕቲቱ 'privately, apart' (lit. 'which his solitude'; here the son is drawn aside alone) · fem. relative before a noun, ሐወጸ እንተ ታዕካ ቤተ መንግሥት 'looked out (?), which the ታዕካ of the palace'; the link to the verb is unclear (?) · 'which is' of the place (እንተ ኀበ ቊልፈትክሙ 'which is at your backside (?)') · 'whose' before a possessed noun (እንተ ስማ አቢስ 'whose name is Abishag') · እንተ የብስ 'which [is] dry land': the relative standing after a feminine noun, ባሕር (ትተረጐም, 3fs, shows it is feminine), 'the sea, which [became] dry land'; a prepositional 'by, on' is possible but less likely (?) · fem. relative or link before an adverb of place, 'who/which [was]' (ወሖረት እንተ ድኅሬሁ 'and she went [she] behind him'; ቆብዐ እንተ መትሕተ አክሊሉ 'a cap which [was] beneath his crown')
glossary.እንዘ: እንዘ — while, whilst (conjunction) · 'while', also 'though' in contrast (እንዘ ክቡር ስምነ 'though our name was honored')
glossary.ኦአቡነ: አብ — O our father (ኦ vocative + noun + -ነ '1cp our', written as one word)
glossary.ከመ: ከመ — that, so that; as · 'like' before a noun (ከመ ምድረ በረድ 'like a land of hail') · ከመ ኢ- 'that not, lest' (ከመ ኢትንገሥ ብእሲት 'that a woman not reign'; ከመ ኢታቅሞ 'that you not make him stay') · 'as when' before ዘ- or አመ (ከመ ዘ ዐገትዋ 'as when they besieged her')
glossary.ኪያሃ: ኪያሃ — her (accusative independent pronoun, 3fs; object of ያኀድጉነ) · object of አማሰኑ 'they destroyed her' (the city)
glossary.ኮነ: ኮነ — he became, was (3m sg perfect, k-w-n) · 3ms form used here where 'we became' is meant (እንዘ ጠቢባን ኮነ አብዳነ; 1cp would be ኮንነ; sic) · 'if it is' after ለእመ (ወለእመ ኮነ ተባዕተ 'and if it is male'); impersonal 'when it was to him' of years (ሶበ ኮነ ሎቱ ፳ወ፪ ዓመተ 'when he was twenty-two') · 3ms form before a plural subject (ኮነ መዋዕሊሁ ፷ 'his days were sixty'); 'there was' (ኮነ ረኃብ 'there was a famine')
glossary.ኵሉ: ኵሉ — all, every, the whole of · 'everyone', used alone (ያፈቅር ኵሉ 'everyone loves') · ወበዝ ኵሉ 'and in all this'
glossary.ወሀለወት: ሀሎ — and she is present, there is (ወ- + 3fs perfect)
glossary.ወለሎጥሰ: ሎጥ — and as for Lot (ወ- + ለ- + proper name + contrastive -ሰ)
glossary.ወለሎጥኒ: ሎጥ — and Lot also (ወ- + ለ- marking the object + proper name + enclitic -ኒ 'also')
glossary.ወለነኒ: ለ — and as for us too (ወ- + ለ- + -ነ '1cp us' + -ኒ 'also')
glossary.ወለአጋራዊያን: አጋራዊ — and to the Hagarites (?) (ወ- + ለ- + plural አጋራዊያን of አጋራዊ, from አጋር 'Hagar') (?)
glossary.ወለደት: ወለደ — she bore, gave birth (3fs perfect)
glossary.ወልደ: ወልድ — son (noun, construct state 'son-of') · accusative 'a son' (ወለደት ወልደ 'she bore a son')
glossary.ወሎጥሰ: ሎጥ — and Lot, as for him (ወ- + proper name + contrastive -ሰ)
glossary.ወመሬተ: መሬት — and earth, soil (ወ- + noun, accusative)
glossary.ወረደ: ወረደ — he went down, descended (3ms perfect, G, w-r-d) · ወ is part of the root, not 'and'
glossary.ወሰመየቶ: ሰመየ — and she named him (ወ- + 3fs perfect + -ኦ '3ms him', joined as ቶ)
glossary.ወሰከበት: ሰከበ — and she lay down (ወ- + 3fs perfect, G)
glossary.ወሰክረ: ሰከረ — and he was drunk (ወ- + 3ms perfect, G)
glossary.ወበተንሥኦታ: ተንሥኦት — and in her rising (ወ- + በ- + verbal noun of ተንሥአ + -ሃ '3fs her', written -ታ)
glossary.ወብእሲቱሰ: ብእሲት — and his wife, as for her (ወ- + noun, fem. + -ሁ '3ms his', spelled -ቱ, + contrastive -ሰ)
glossary.ወተከለ: ተከለ — and he planted (ወ- + 3ms perfect, G)
glossary.ወናሁኬ: ናሁ — and behold indeed (ወ- + particle + emphatic -ኬ)
glossary.ወናየድዐክሙ: አየድዐ — and we shall inform you (ወ- + 1cp imperfect, ʾa-stem causative of y-d-ʿ + -ክሙ '2mp you') (?)
glossary.ወንጉሠ: ንጉሥ — and king of (ወ- + noun, construct)
glossary.ወኖኅሂ: ኖኅ — and Noah also (ወ- + proper name + enclitic -ሂ 'also')
glossary.ወአማሰኑ: አማሰነ — and they destroyed (ወ- + 3mp perfect, causative of ማሰነ 'perish')
glossary.ወአስተያሁ: አስተየ — and they (f.) made him drink (ወ- + 3fp perfect, ʾa-stem causative of ሰትየ 'drink', + -ሁ 'him')
glossary.ወአስከራሁ: አስከረ — and they (f.) made him drunk (ወ- + 3fp perfect, ʾa-stem causative of ሰከረ 'be drunk', + -ሁ 'him')
glossary.ወአንቲኒ: አንቲ — and you also (ወ- + 2fs independent pronoun + enclitic -ኒ 'also')
glossary.ወአውግረ: አውግር — and hills (?) (ወ- + plural noun, accusative; meaning uncertain) (?)
glossary.ወአውፅእዎ: አውፅአ — and they brought him out (ወ- + 3mp perfect, ʾa-stem causative of ወፅአ, + -ዎ 'him')
glossary.ወኢያእመረ: አእመረ — and he did not know (ወ- + ኢ- + 3ms perfect, ʾa-stem)
glossary.ወእማ: እም — and her mother (ወ- + noun እም 'mother' + -ሃ '3fs her', written -ማ)
glossary.ወውእቱሰ: ውእቱ — and he, as for him (ወ- + pronoun + contrastive -ሰ)
glossary.ወውእቱኬ: ውእቱ — and he indeed (ወ- + 3ms independent pronoun + emphatic -ኬ)
glossary.ወያውዕይዋ: አውዐየ — and that they burn her (ወ- + 3mp subjunctive, ʾa-stem causative of ወዐየ 'burn' (?), + -ዋ '3fs her') (?)
glossary.ወይቤላ: ይቤ — and he said to her (ወ- + 3ms perfect of defective ይቤ + -ላ '3fs to her') · masculine form where a woman speaks to her sister and ትቤላ is expected (ወይቤላ ዝንቱ ንዋየ አቡነ 'and she said to her: this property of our father') (?)
glossary.ወይነ: ወይን — wine (noun, accusative) · 'vine' (ትተክል ወይነ 'you will plant a vine')
glossary.ወደቂቁ: ደቂቅ — and his children, sons (ወ- + noun + -u 'his')
glossary.ወደገማ: ደገመ — and they (f.) repeated (ወ- + 3fp perfect, G)
glossary.ወገሞራ: ገሞራ — and Gomorrah (ወ- + proper name, place)
glossary.ወጸልመ: ጸልመ — and it was darkened (ወ- + 3ms perfect, G)
glossary.ወፀዓዓት: ፀዓዓት — and (?) unidentified word, perhaps hail or another storm-sign (ወ- + noun?) (?)
glossary.ወፃእክሙ: ወፅአ — you (pl.) went out (2mp perfect, G, w-ṣ-ʾ; the ወ is part of the root, not 'and')
glossary.ውሉዶ: ውሉድ — his son (noun ውሉድ 'son, begotten', which also serves as plural of ወልድ, + -ሁ '3ms his'; anticipates the genitive ለአቡየ)
glossary.ውስተ: ውስተ — in, within, into · to, among (ወለአከ ውስተ ኵሉ ነጋድያን 'and he sent to all the merchants') · at (ውስተ መድረከ ኆኃቲሃ 'at the threshold of her doors')
glossary.ውእቱ: ውእቱ — he, it (3ms independent pronoun; also serves as copula 'is')
glossary.ዓማሌቅ: ዓማሌቅ — Amalek (proper name, people and ancestor)
glossary.ዓሞን: ዓሞን — Ammon (proper name, Lot's younger daughter's son)
glossary.ዘርአ: ዘርእ — seed (construct 'seed of') · also 'seed' as sown grain, absolute (ዘርአ ወማእረረ 'seed(time) and harvest') · accusative 'offspring' (ይሁበኒ እግዚኣብሔር ዘርአ 'may God give me offspring') · in apposition to ውሉድ: 'offspring' (አልቦውሉደ ዘርአ 'no child, no seed')
glossary.ዘከመሂ: ዘከመ — how also, in what way too (ዘከመ 'how' + enclitic -ሂ 'also')
glossary.ዘያነድድ: አነደደ — that burns, which sets ablaze (ዘ- + 3ms imperfect, ʾa-stem causative of ነደደ 'burn')
glossary.ዘያወስበነ: አውሰበ — who will marry us, give us a husband (?) (ዘ- + 3ms imperfect, ʾa-stem causative of ወሰበ 'take a wife', + -ነ '1cp us') (?)
glossary.ዘያጠይሶ: አጠየሰ — that blackens him/it (?) (ዘ- + 3ms imperfect, ʾa-stem causative of a verb 'blacken' (?), + -ሁ) (?)
glossary.ዝናመ: ዝናም — rain (noun, accusative) · construct 'rain of' (ዝናመ እሳት 'rain of fire')
glossary.ያውፅእዎ: አውፅአ — that they bring him out (3mp subjunctive, ʾa-stem causative of ወፅአ 'go out', + -ዎ 'him')
glossary.ያጥፍኦሙ: አጥፍአ — that he destroy them (3ms subjunctive, ʾa-stem causative of ጠፍአ 'perish', + -ሙ '3mp them')
glossary.ያጸልም: አጸለመ — it darkens (3ms imperfect, ʾa-stem causative of ጸልመ)
glossary.ይረግም: ረገመ — he curses, that he curse (3ms imperfect/subjunctive, G, after እስከ)
glossary.ይቤልዎ: ብህለ — they said to him (3mp perf. ይቤሉ + ሎ 'to him', written ይቤልዎ)
glossary.ይብላ: ይቤ — they (f.) say (3fp imperfect ይብላ of defective ይቤ)
glossary.ይትናዘዝ: ተናዘዘ — that it be comforted (3ms subjunctive, tä-stem)
glossary.ይእቲ: ይእቲ — she/it is (fem. pron.) · 'I am she' predicate (አነ ይእቲ አቡከ 'I am she, your father') · 'that' (fem. demonstrative, ይእቲ ሠሉስ ዕለት 'that third day') · 'she' restating the subject, a resumptive pronoun before a noun (ይእቲ ባሕርይ 'she, the pearl')
glossary.ይእቲኒ: ይእቲ — she too (3fs independent pronoun + emphatic -ኒ)
glossary.ይጠፍእ: ጠፍአ — he/it vanishes, perishes (3ms imperfect, G, ṭ-f-ʾ)
glossary.ድኅሬሃ: ድኅረ — behind her, her back (noun/preposition ድኅሬ- + -ሃ '3fs her')
glossary.ገብረ: ገብረ — make, do (3ms perfect) · here the noun ገብር 'servant' in the construct state, ገብረ ፈርዖን 'servant of Pharaoh' · accusative 'a slave' after አልቦ (ወአልቦ ገብረ 'and there is no slave')
glossary.ገብራ: ገብር — her servant (noun + -ኣ 'her') · they (f.) made, did (3fp perfect, G; here a verb, not 'her servant')
glossary.ጸልመ: ጸልመ — it was dark, darkened (3ms perfect, G)
glossary.ፄው: ፄው — salt (noun; spelled with ፄ, perhaps for ጼው (?))
glossary.ፈቀደ: ፈቀደ — he wished, wanted, desired (3ms perfect, G)
glossary.ፈነወ: ፈነወ — he sent (3ms perfect, G, f-n-w)
